findings.title_en: Unsecured tools and materials on scaffold platforms
Dangling cable in the work walkway
Edge protection and work-at-height controls cannot be verified
Weight of the metal fittings load cannot be verified

summary_en: Five findings were recorded: zero high severity, two medium severity, and three low severity, including two uncertain findings. The most urgent confirmed item is the unsecured tools and materials on the scaffold platforms in the foreground of frame 0. A site-wide work stoppage is not required, but the platforms must be secured and the cable removed from the walkway before they are used again.
